_note: Bundled /me-mote seed table. Each entry: id (stable key) + per-language { name, aliases?, text_default, text_you?, text_all? }. The seeder copies entries that aren't already in the user's catalog (matched by id) when SeedBundledMeMotes(lang) runs (entry.cpp's AddonLoad after the user picks an emote language). Bodies carry the variant text only — '/me ' is prepended at send time in SendOrFillMeMote. The first-run lane is 'I'd type this in chat anyway, no animation matches' — group-coordination calls (LFG, Ready check, Need healer, etc.), not duplicates of animated emotes (/wave, /sigh). Falls back to 'en' when a language is absent for the chosen entry. EN + DE shipped now; FR/ES land as future translation passes (the loader's EN fallback keeps the catalog usable until then).
